why: gorge's payment planner prices a sacrifice-another-creature mana source as a last-resort step (pay/planshape.go, victims ranked tokens first, then lowest mana value, then id) and offers every cast it alone makes payable, with the victims in the plan; dirac's planner has no such source tier, so it withholds those casts (and, on the full surface, differs in what the plan sacrifices) (tail-68 pair 4)
